title: BGN regime-gamma at g0235's multipliers, stressed two thirds of the time
question: Can BGN produce a gap over linear methods that are given the market on equal terms?
notes:
B4 (docs/RESULTS.md, BGN proposals). IDENTICAL to var-bgn_gam-g0235-v2 except the two switch probabilities, SWAPPED: calm-to-stress 0.25/12 -> 0.50/12 and stress-to-calm 0.50/12 -> 0.25/12. The stationary stress share is two thirds instead of one third, in stress spells averaging 48 months between 24-month calm spells. gmult stays [0.2, 3.5]; the J* table is re-solved because p01/p10 enter it through Preg.

WHY: finding 8 says DKKM leaves the market only where the Sharpe the market does not span is large. Within g0235s a seed's evaluation-window stress share correlates 0.97-0.99 with its SR_max, room and DKKM, and the only BGN seed with a large non-market Sharpe (g0235s seed 2, 0.40) was stressed in 84% of its months.

PREDICTION (2026-09-13): evaluation-window room above +0.04; non-market Sharpe sqrt(SR_max^2 - SR_ew^2) 0.2 to 0.3; DKKM 0.03 to 0.06 above the EW market; and a FAIR gap -- best DKKM minus the best linear method including those given the market unpenalised (linrank_m, linlev_m, mkt_est) -- of only +0.005 to +0.015, because BGN's within-regime premium is close to affine in book-to-price and 1/price.

SCREEN: seed 0 runs first. Seeds 1-9 run only if seed 0's evaluation-window room is at least +0.05 AND its evaluation-window non-market Sharpe (oracle sr_orth_eval) at least 0.30. If the screen misses, BGN's regime path is finished.

PRECOMMITMENT: the jstar id below was computed from these parameters and the current source WITHOUT solving, via _scratch/precommit_id.sh, whose path was re-validated the same minute by recomputing g0235f's 8662d7c1079f4b41. This spec is committed BEFORE variants/run_solve_slurm.sh builds the table, so git can certify the order.
